articles.title: Iran's top diplomat speaks with Gulf leaders about tensions, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran’s top diplomat has spoken with Persian Gulf leaders amid regional tensions over potential U.S. military actions. On Thursday, Iran Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi held calls with Turkey and several Gulf leaders, discussing security and stability. Meanwhile, Russian President Vladimir Putin met with Iran’s security chief, Mohsen Rezaei. The Kremlin did not provide details about the meeting. In other developments, U.S. President Donald Trump spoke with Iraq’s Prime Minister about regional security. Additionally, Israel’s president says he will announce on Sunday whether current Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will get the first chance at forming its next government.
